overview.description: The Tema Healthcare AI ETF (HLTH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in companies applying artificial intelligence across the healthcare industry. The fund seeks long-term capital growth by investing in businesses using AI to transform healthcare products, services, and operations. HLTH was launched on Jul 20, 2026 and is issued by Tema.
